text_block_list.text:
Having claimed a magnificent victory in 
the Satsuki Sho, Tokai Teio points a 
single finger... high toward the heavens.

It was the exact same pose Symboli Rudolf 
struck when she won the Satsuki Sho. In 
it, one could feel her unshakeable will to 
claim the Triple Crown.

Her next target is the Tokyo Yushun 
(Japanese Derby). She dashed forward 
toward the glory that every Umamusume 
desires.
